SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Announce element in pointing direction
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summaryOn: Hold phone horizontally and point to announce the nearest map element

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Include ways (roads, paths)
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summaryOn: Roads and paths in the pointing direction will also be announced
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summaryOff: Only points of interest will be announced, not roads or paths

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Proximity and movement announcements
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summaryOn: Announces the nearest point to your location and in your direction of travel
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summaryOff: Proximity and movement-based announcements are disabled
